text:
Jordan: Quick check — planning a gradual unveil of the console feature gate `feature_preview_v2`. Proposal: enable the hidden setting for a 5% canary across customer orgs + 100% for internal/dev orgs. Main asks: who will flip the flag, what's the exact scope, and what guardrails do we want live before the flip?

Mira: 5% sounds fine but can we start at 2% on the first day? Staging showed a small increase in render latency with long org lists. If we see >10% p95 increase, revert immediately.

Kevin: I can flip it via the admin API. Quick curl to run in case useful:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example.com/admin/feature-flags/feature_preview_v2/enable \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \\
  -d '{"scope":"percent:5","include_orgs":["redwood-internal","devops-test"]}'
```

Sasha: I'll own the flip and run the monitoring playbook. Prefer to do it Tue 10:00 PST after the morning standby. I'll watch traces and error rates for the first 30 minutes and keep a private channel open. PR for console exposure gate is up: repo/ui#342 (needs one more code-review).

Jordan: repo/ui#342 — pinging @Kevin for the last review. Also adding guardrails we discussed:
- telemetry: emit `console.feature_preview_v2.enabled` per-org + sample traces
- autop-revert: if p95 latency increases by >10% for 15m OR error rate spikes >0.5% absolute, auto-revert
- manual kill: global `feature_preview_v2_off` toggle in the admin UI

Ciara: I'll run the post-rollout smoke tests and the query perf checks. Dashboards to watch: `console.ui.latency`, `console.api.500s`, `feature_preview_v2.usage`. I'll set alerts at 10% p95 delta and 0.3% error delta. Also will verify A/B content correctness for a sample of users.

Mira: One more ask — can we gate the canary by org size? Smaller orgs first (<=50 users) to reduce blast radius. If the flagging service supports an "org_size" attribute we can do 3-tier rollout: internal/dev -> small orgs (2%) -> broader 5%.

Sasha: Good call. I'll update the flip payload to include attribute filters. Kevin, can the admin API accept attribute-based scopes?

Kevin: Yep, the admin system accepts JSON conditions. Example payload snippet: `{"scope":{"percent":5, "attributes":{"org_size":"<=50"}}}`. I'll put a snippet in the runbook.

Jordan: Communication plan: Once Sasha flips, @product-marketing — can you draft a short note for the beta cohort? Nothing public, just a hello + opt-out link. Also ops-notify in the private channel for the first hour.

product-marketing: Got it — we'll prepare a 1-paragraph note and the opt-out link. Target to send 30m after a stable 60m.

rollout-bot: Deploybot: Canary roll command queued by Sasha at 2026-03-17T10:00:00Z for `feature_preview_v2` (scope: internal orgs + small orgs).

Sasha: Kicking off at 10:00 PST. I'll post status updates here every 10m for first 30m.

Kevin: Thumbs up. I added the auto-revert rule in the flag config: `revert_if_latency_pct_change_gt=10` `window_mins=15`.

Ciara: First smoke pass done (internal orgs) — no errors, p95 stable. Moving to small orgs roll (2%).

Mira: Watching dashboards — p95 +3% so far, well within guardrails.

Sasha: Small orgs at 2% done. No immediate regressions. Bumping to 5% for small orgs now.

rollout-bot: Deploybot: Canary reached 5% for small orgs at 2026-03-17T10:24:00Z.

Jordan: Great. We'll keep monitoring for the next 24h and then evaluate expanding the audience. Thanks everyone — please mark LGTM on repo/ui#342 when you have a minute. :thumbsup:

Kevin: LGTM.

Ciara: LGTM and tests green.

Mira: LGTM.

Sasha: Closing the loop — I'll send a short post-mortem doc in #eng-postmortems if anything unusual happens.

Jordan: Perfect. If anyone sees unexpected client-side UX regressions, file a bug and tag me.
